further_increases_reach: main stem of the Ottawa River
forecast_text: Flows and water levels along the main stem of the Ottawa River are within seasonal values for this time of year. Flows and levels are expected to remain fairly stable before increasing gradually, depending on location, toward the end of the week with forecasted rainfall. At some locations, water levels are below navigational chart datums. See the SPECIAL FEATURE section on our Home Page for our summertime message.
